I am against most uses for AI but I do appreciate people who prank that infernal tech. Here's one guy's conversation with ChatGPT about missing out on the James Bond role. 

Instagram user @tomscibelli jokingly complained that Robert Pattinson had been cast as the next 007 instead of him. Things only got funnier from there! 😂 

#JamesBond #RobertPattinson #ChatGPT #AI
